name: KiCad Track Gloss
description: Shorten or simplify PCB connections seeded by selected track segments.
description_full: KiCad Track Gloss is a silent one-click ActionPlugin that automatically expands every selected straight-track seed through KiCad connectivity up to pads, vias, arcs, locks, or junctions, then replaces safe staircases with shorter or simpler 0/45/90-degree chains directly on the current board. It reads KiCad board constraints and effective netclasses, generates deterministic global and multi-net batch candidates, applies the highest-saving plan, and returns immediately. Copper outside the expanded connections remains immutable and KiCad Undo can revert the action.
